[[Emmaus, Pennsylvania]] | former_school(s)= | awards = }} '''Aaron Michael Gray''', (born [[December 7]], [[1984]] in [[Tarzana, Los Angeles, California|Tarzana, California]]) is an American [[college basketball]] [[center (basketball)|center]] who most recently played for the [[University of Pittsburgh Panthers#Men's Basketball|Pittsburgh Panthers]], before graduating in 2007. He is expected to be a potential late first-round or early second round pickhttp://www.nbadraft.net/ in the [[2007 NBA Draft]], which will be held [[June 28]], [[2007]] in [[New York City]]. In March 2007, Gray was named an [[Associated Press]] "All-American", after helping lead the University of Pittsburgh to the Sweet 16 in the [[2007 NCAA Men's Division I Basketball Tournament]], also held in March 2007. [[Image:aarongray.jpg|left|thumb|]] Gray played high school basketball at [[Emmaus High School]] in [[Pennsylvania]]'s [[Lehigh Valley Conference]]. At the NBA's 2007 pre-draft camp, Gray was the only player whose height measured at least seven feet without shoes. He is 7'0" and weighs 271 pounds. ==Season by season totals==
